{{Use dmy dates|date=March 2026}}
'''Alexei Simașchevici''' (27 June 1929 – 26 January 2026) was a Moldovan physicist.<ref>{{Cite web |title=IN MEMORIAM ACADEMICIAN ALEXEI SIMAȘCHEVICI |url=https://asm.md/memoriam-academician-alexei-simaschevici |access-date=2 February 2026 |website=asm.md |language=ro}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
Simașchevici was born on 27 June 1929. He was a full member of the [[Academy of Sciences of Moldova]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Membrii Academiei de Științe a Moldovei {{!}} Academia de Științe a Moldovei |url=https://asm.md/membri |access-date=2 February 2026 |website=asm.md}}</ref>  He was a member of the [[Communist Party of the Soviet Union|CPSU]].

Simașchevici died on 26 January 2026, at the age of 96.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Necrolog Alexei Simașchevici (27 iunie 1929 – 26 ianuarie 2026) – Universitatea de Stat din Moldova |url=https://usm.md/?p=44842 |access-date=2 February 2026 |website=usm.md}}</ref>

== Awards ==
Simașchevici was awarded the [[Order of Labour (Moldova)|Order of Labour]], first class, and in 2019 he was awarded the [[Order of the Republic (Moldova)|Order of the Republic]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Alexey Simashkevich – Institute of Applied Physics |url=https://ifa.usm.md/alexey-simashkevich/ |access-date=2 February 2026 |language=en-US}}</ref>
